paper_title: 1.4 Million Open-Source Distilled Reasoning Dataset to Empower Large   Language Model Training
caption: Difficulty distribution of the data entries. Most of the dataset entries are classified as Medium (51.8%) or Hard (25.7%). A smaller proportion falls into the Easy (11.2%), Very Hard (6.5%), and Very Easy (4.7%) categories.

The slices are labeled with percentages and correspond to: Medium in pink at approximately 51.8%, Hard in blue at approximately 25.7%, Easy in light green at approximately 11.2%, Very hard in light orange at approximately 6.5%, and Very easy in light lavender/purple at approximately 4.7%. A legend labeled “Difficulty” appears in the upper-left and lists each category with associated counts (Medium 725,892; Hard 360,137; Easy 157,053; Very hard 91,576; Very easy 65,332).
